newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks strong, Nasdaq makes gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks strong, Nasdaq makes gains.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks were firm in morning trade and the Nasdaq composite pushed higher, as optimism prevailed about upcoming June earnings reports.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 35 points, or 0.4 percent, at 7893. The Nasdaq composite, heavily weighted with technology stocks, rose 2.29 points to 1473.

"The main concern coming into the day was earnings," George Rodriguez, senior vice president, equities at Guzman & Co said. "The general consensus is for those earnings to be in line with expectations."

Motorola Inc was scheduled to report second quarter earnings after the market close on Tuesday. Analysts said they expected earnings to have grown slightly from the first quarter's $0.53 per share and last year's $0.54.
Chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices Inc was also due to report second quarter earnings after the close.
Analysts cautioned that any earnings disappointments would create turmoil in equity markets.
The long bond was down 7/32 at a 6.59 percent yield.
